title: 第374章 冠权敕赐第373章 名为统御败于温柔
slug: 迷雾求生从流民开始的领主之路

第374章冠权敕赐
翌日，清晨。
厚重的橡木门被推开，亚修面无表情地跨过门槛，径直走到白银之座前坐下。
大厅内，庄园的核心骨干们早已列队等候。
只是今天的气氛，透着一股极其诡异的静谧。
没人说话。
往日里总喜欢高谈阔论的盖尔，此刻正低头死死盯着地砖的纹理，仿佛那上面长出了一朵花；西奥和罗德眼观鼻鼻观心，站得像两根没有生命的木桩。
大家都知道了。
但，谁也不敢说，甚至连一个多余的眼神都不敢乱飞。
唯独站在门口的巴顿，那张年轻的黑脸憋得发紫，腮帮子高高鼓起，双肩抖得连身上的铁鳞甲都在“咔咔”作响。
他快憋不住了。
亚修眼角微不可察地抽动了一下。
“巴顿。”
“噗——咳！在！亚修大哥，我在！”
巴顿浑身一激灵，赶紧站直身子，但那嘴角却怎么也压不下去。
亚修的后槽牙暗暗咬紧，脸上却毫无波澜：
“我看你最近气血翻涌，精力无处发泄。”
“去，把庄园后头那二十头石鳞巨蜥的粪坑全清理一遍。不铲出反光来，今天不许吃肉。”
“啊？！”巴顿傻眼了，委屈地瞪大眼睛，“亚修大哥，为什么是我？我什么都没笑啊！”
“现在加倍，连灰羽鸡的鸡圈也一起扫了。”亚修幽幽开口。

巴顿顿时如丧考妣，耷拉着脑袋，灰溜溜地领命滚出了大厅。
亚修轻咳一声，收敛了那丝不易察觉的恼羞成怒，神色骤然转为肃穆。
“言归正传。”
他的声音沉了下来，一股无形的威压犹如实质般在厅内弥漫，“今日召你们来，是宣布一件事。”
众人神色一凛，立刻收起了杂念。
“昨日我已正式跨过天堑，晋升三阶。”
“而我所掌握的三阶权能，名为——「烬冠敕赐」。”
“它的其中一项效果名为「封君」，可以让我册封5名臣属，接受薪火洗礼，构筑能量之源。”
“也就是说……我可以让你们强行打破阶位桎梏，直接晋升为伪三阶！”
轰！
大厅内，所有人的呼吸在这一刻彻底粗重了起来。
三阶！
那是多少人梦寐以求、甚至不惜献祭灵魂的渴求。
哪怕是带个“伪”字，那也是跨越了生命层次的天堑！
现在，大人只要一句话，就能量产五个？
“目前，我手里的名额只有五个。”

Chapter 374: The Imperial Grant
The next day, early morning.
The heavy oak door was pushed open, Ash stepped across the threshold expressionlessly, walked straight to the Silver Seat and sat down.
In the hall, the core members of the manor were already waiting in line.
It's just that the atmosphere today is filled with an extremely strange silence.
No one spoke.
Gale, who always liked to talk loudly in the past, was now looking down at the texture of the floor tiles, as if a flower had grown on it; Theo and Rhodes were staring at each other, standing like two lifeless wooden stakes.
Everyone knows it.
However, no one dared to say anything, not even to cast an unnecessary glance.
Barton was the only one standing at the door, his young black face turned purple from holding back, his cheeks bulging high, and his shoulders shaking so much that even the iron scale armor on his body was "rattling".
He couldn't hold it in any longer.
The corners of Ash's eyes twitched imperceptibly.
"Barton."
"Pfft-cough! Here! Brother Ash, I'm here!"
Barton was agitated and quickly stood up straight, but he couldn't suppress the corner of his mouth.
Ya Xiu clenched his back molars secretly, but his face showed no emotion:
"I see that your blood has been raging lately and you have nowhere to vent your energy."
"Go and clean out the cesspools of the twenty stone-scaled monitor lizards behind the manor. If you don't shovel out the reflections, you won't be allowed to eat meat today."
"Ah?!" Barton was dumbfounded and his eyes widened in grievance, "Brother Ashus, why me? I didn't smile at all!"
"Now double that, even the chicken pens of the gray-feathered chickens will be swept away." Yaxiu said quietly.
Barton suddenly felt like he was mourning for his heir, his head drooped, and he followed the order and rolled out of the hall dejectedly.
Ash coughed slightly, suppressing his imperceptible anger, and his expression suddenly turned solemn.
"Back to business."
His voice deepened, and an invisible coercion filled the hall as if it were real. "I've called you here today to announce something."
Everyone looked stern and immediately put away their distracting thoughts.
"Yesterday I officially crossed the chasm and was promoted to the third level."
"And the third-level power I control is called - "Emperor Crown Edict". "
"One of its effects is called "Search", which allows me to ennoble 5 subjects, accept the baptism of fire, and build a source of energy. "
"That is to say...I can let you forcefully break the shackles of rank and directly promote to pseudo-third rank! "
Boom!
Everyone in the hall was breathing heavily at this moment.
Level three!
That is the desire that many people dream of, even at the expense of sacrificing their souls.
Even if the word "fake" is used, it is a chasm that transcends the level of life!
Now, with just one word, adults can produce five?
“Currently, I only have five spots in hand. "
